signaling_summary: Per-Lane low-voltage differential signaling on TXp/TXn and RXp/RXn pairs, NRZ (two-level), at 32 GT/s per Lane per direction (Gen5). Both ends are AC-coupled. Gen5 mandates a four-phase enhanced transmitter-equalization handshake (Phase 0-3) with preset hints, supports optional transmitter precoding, allows up to two protocol-aware retimers per link, and mandates Lane Margining at the Receiver. Encoding is 128b/130b; the embedded clock is recovered by the receiver CDR from the scrambled block stream.
modulation: NRZ (two-level). PAM4 is NOT used at Gen5 (it is a PCIe 6.0 feature).

transmitter_specs_canonical.equalization: Four-phase enhanced equalization (Phase 0, 1, 2, 3) with transmitter coefficient / preset exchange.
transmitter_specs_canonical.precoding: Optional transmitter precoding to reduce DFE burst-error propagation at 32 GT/s.

receiver_specs_canonical.ctle_dfe: CTLE + DFE required to open the eye at 32 GT/s.
receiver_specs_canonical.lane_margining_at_receiver: Mandatory. Steps the receiver sampling point in time (left/right) and optionally voltage (up/down) and reports the error rate, exposing each lane's eye margin while in L0 without interrupting traffic.

retimers.definition: A protocol-aware PHY extension device that recovers clock and data, re-equalizes, and retransmits to extend electrical channel reach.
retimers.max_introduced: The two-retimer maximum was introduced in PCIe 4.0 and carried into PCIe 5.0.
retimers.equalization_participation: Each retimer participates in the Phase 0-3 equalization handshake (adds latency).
retimers.vs_redriver: A retimer is a clean-and-retime digital repeater; a redriver is an analog amplifier only.

equalization_phases.Phase_0: Initial preset exchange; partners + retimers adopt the requested transmitter preset.
equalization_phases.Phase_1: Coefficient fine-tuning toward the training direction.
equalization_phases.Phase_2: Downstream port adjusts upstream port TX coefficients.
equalization_phases.Phase_3: Upstream port adjusts downstream port TX coefficients; eye must be open before sustaining 32 GT/s.

lane_margining.scope: At the Receiver, in L0, without interrupting traffic.
lane_margining.time_margining: Steps the sampling point left/right and reports error count.
lane_margining.voltage_margining: Optionally steps the threshold up/down and reports error count.
lane_margining.transport: Carried in the Lane Margining at the Receiver registers / margining control-skip ordered sets.

electrical_idle.definition: Differential transmitter output is undriven (or held at common mode); no symbol stream produced.
electrical_idle.indicated_by: EIOS (Electrical Idle Ordered Set) before the transmitter enters Electrical Idle.
electrical_idle.exit_indication: EIEOS or FTS Ordered Sets, depending on the LTSSM exit state.

encoding_role_in_analog: The 128b/130b code (scrambled payload + 2-bit sync header) provides DC balance and transition density for the receiver CDR; precoding additionally limits how far a single DFE decision error can propagate as a burst at 32 GT/s.
